**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | Treat `undefined` as `false` |

The 8 remaining warnings are real deprecations. `fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, and a circular import between `src/core/graph.js` and `src/state/tracker.js`. Say the word and I'll clear those too.
